question: Who among the following founded the ‘Forward Bloc’?
solution:
correct answer is** __​Subhas Chandra Bose__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The **All India Forward Bloc (AIFB)** is a **left-wing nationalist political party in India**.
 
• The **emerged as a faction within the Indian National Congress **in **1939, led by Subhas Chandra Bose.**
 
• The main **objective **of the** Forward Bloc was to establish a classless society and follow the ideals of Socialism****.**
 
• The **Presidency** was assumed by **Bose **and** SS Cavasheer became the Vice President.**
 
• The **Indian National Army also known as the Azad Hind Fauj was founded by Netaji **to fight for the freedom of India.
